objective: First-party production Pine dependency inventory to guide safe zero-Pine removal.
evidence: package.json dependencies were inspected; Pine features are implemented in first-party source modules and connected through internal imports.

nodes.role: Imports and registers PineV6Frontend beside CoreScriptFrontend.
Pine header/declaration adapter; calls shared parser with pine:true.
One shared parser has explicit pine mode state.
Frontend ID and shared AST retain Pine declaration metadata.
IR type surface imports Pine declaration metadata.
Direct imports of Pine builtin definition/executability/argument validation.
Pine signatures and overloads with supported, partial, host-bound and catalog-only registrations.
31 Pine feature definitions plus evidence-based status calculation.
Pine status, fixture and compatibility type contracts.
Mixed namespace registry includes Pine-derived roots such as ta/request/array/matrix/map/str/color/input/syminfo/barstate.
Public exports of Pine registry and Pine math adapter.
Maps Pine strategy command envelopes into generic simulation-only actions.
Registers six Pine-specific contracts in the primary suite.

builtinRegistrationCounts.basis: Syntactic helper calls in pineBuiltinRegistry.ts; not unique API signatures or runtime coverage.

legacyStatusRule: A missing implementation-file list yields not_implemented; known differences or failed fixtures yield partially_conformant; explicit host_limited evidence yields host_limited; absent fixture evidence yields implemented_unverified; conformant requires all declared fixtures passed and no known differences.
safeRemovalSequence: Replace native builtin signatures, type validation, runtime providers and editor completions with CoreSpirit-owned definitions.
Move compatibility parsing to an isolated conformance harness outside the native compiler/runtime package.
Remove Pine-specific AST/IR metadata only after native declaration contracts and artifact migration exist.
Remove Pine-specific strategy command adapter only after native simulation command semantics are independently specified.
Remove Pine re-exports, namespace aliases, frontend registration, test entries and source files after import graph reports zero production references.
